# Power source (`power_source`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Device · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when the computer runs on the given power source.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `is` | one of: `ac`, `battery` | yes |  | ac (plugged in) or battery. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: power_source
    is: battery
```

## Notes

Desktop PCs without a battery always report `ac`.
